2608.30923.title: Towards Stream Learning on Embedded Systems: Benchmarking the Memory Consumption of Stream Learning Methods
2608.30923.paper_summary: Stream learning is commonly evaluated through predictive performance and adaptation to concept drift. However, sustained operation of a stream learner also requires predictable and bounded resource usage even on long streams. This requirement becomes even more critical when learning moves from servers to near-sensor embedded systems where memory and processing are scarce resources. In state-of-the-art stream learning, however, we perceive a strong focus on concept drift adaptation, whereas resource usage is often an evaluation byproduct. To close this gap, we benchmark seven representative stream classifiers on 13 real and synthetic streams under model-size budgets from 128\,KiB to approximately 8\,MiB. Our benchmark comprises a total of 6,463 experiments. We measure failure-aware accuracy, peak model size, time to budget exhaustion, and prediction-plus-update latency. The results reveal two distinct resource failure modes. Adaptive ensembles can exceed small budgets almost immediately because of their initial footprint, even when their size remains stable thereafter. Incremental trees can fit initially but grow throughout a long stream, with HoeffdingTrees (HT) and Extremely Fast Decision Trees (EFDT) increasing by median factors of 7.37 and 5.87. Explicitly compact methods remain the only viable option under the smallest budgets, but are usually overtaken as larger budgets make adaptive ensembles competitive. Hence, many state-of-the-art methods are only partially applicable in embedded systems or for long-running systems. We therefore call on the stream-learning community to make bounded resource usage a first-class design objective alongside drift adaptation, and propose concrete steps toward this goal, including an API through which stream learners can explicitly expose and respect resource budgets.
2608.30923.paper_summary_zh: 流式學習通常通過預測性能和對概念漂移的適應性來評估。然而，流式學習者的持續運行還需要在長時間流中具有可預測和有限的資源使用。當學習從伺服器轉移到接近感測器的嵌入式系統時，這一要求變得更加關鍵，因為記憶體和處理能力是稀缺資源。然而，在最先進的流式學習中，我們感受到對概念漂移適應的強烈關注，而資源使用往往只是評估的副產品。為了填補這一空白，我們在模型大小預算從128\,KiB到約8\,MiB的情況下，對13個真實和合成流中的七個代表性流分類器進行基準測試。我們的基準測試共計進行了6,463次實驗。我們測量了失敗感知準確性、峰值模型大小、預算耗盡時間和預測加更新延遲。結果揭示了兩種不同的資源失敗模式。自適應集成幾乎可以立即超過小預算，因為它們的初始佔用空間，即使其大小隨後保持穩定。增量樹可以在初始時適應，但在長時間流中會增長，其中HoeffdingTrees (HT)和極快決策樹 (EFDT)的增長中位數分別為7.37和5.87。在最小預算下，顯式緊湊方法仍然是唯一可行的選擇，但通常會被較大預算下的自適應集成所超越。因此，許多最先進的方法在嵌入式系統或長期運行的系統中僅部分適用。因此，我們呼籲流式學習社群將有限的資源使用作為一級設計目標，與漂移適應並重，並提出具體步驟以實現這一目標，包括一個API，通過該API流式學習者可以明確地暴露和遵守資源預算。
